provider: CUHK Department of Mathematics 2026 Enrichment entrants advice and current Stream requirements
academicYear: Applicable to Enrichment Mathematics entrants in 2026; Stream requirements in force since August 2025
note: The official 2026 entrants advice assigns Enrichment Mathematics entrants to four first-year Honours MATH courses, permits the published non-Honours counterparts, and then requires the common Table C0 courses plus Table C1 for students remaining in the Enrichment Stream. The current Stream page states that Enrichment entrants are automatically placed in the Enrichment Stream and publishes a 33-unit Stream structure: both MATH2070/2078 and MATH2230, then 27 units across named pools including 15-21 units from the main advanced pool. This supplement exposes 54 unique, explicitly named MATH courses from those first-year, C0, C1, Capstone and Enrichment Stream pools. Titles and units are confirmed by the current official Course List or the linked official course pages; MATH2221 is 2 units and every other imported course is 3 units. The Stream also permits up to 6 units from any otherwise-unused MATH course at level 3000 or above, and entrants may migrate to or combine other Streams. That open elective universe, double-Stream rules, University and Faculty requirements, prerequisites and permission for level-5000 courses are not closed here. The resulting list is intentionally browse-only and must not produce a graduation completion percentage.
